questions.questionTextEn: Itaipu Dam built on the river Parana is one of the largest dams in the world. Which of the following two countries have it as a joint project?
questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 1995] Itaipu Dam built on the river Parana is one of the largest dams in the world. Which of the following two countries have it as a joint project?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) Brazil and Paraguay. Itaipu Dam is a joint venture between Brazil and Paraguay (both South American countries) at Itaipu of Brazil and Paraguay border on the Parana river. The dam is 196 metre high and 7919 metre long. [I.A.S. (Pre) 1995]
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (C) Brazil and Paraguay। व्याख्या (33.
